p: year of Jehoiakim the son of: Read Geneva "Jer 25:1"
from the days of Josiah: Which were twenty and three years, as in Jer 25:3 counting from the thirteenth year of Josiah's reign.
from the mouth of Jeremiah all: As he indicted.
shut up: Meaning, in prison through the malice of the priests.
day of fasting: Which was proclaimed for fear of the Babylonians, as their custom was when they feared war, or any great plague of God.
present their supplication before the LORD: He shows that fasting without prayer and repentance does nothing but is mere hypocrisy.

year of Jehoiakim the son of: The fast was then proclaimed and Baruch read this rule which was a little before Jerusalem was first taken, and then Jehoiakim and Daniel and his companions were led away captive.
new gate of the LORD'S house: Which is the East gate of the temple.
afraid both one and another: The godly were afraid, seeing God so offended, and the wicked were astonished for the horror of the punishment.

hide thyself: They who were godly among the princes gave this counsel by whose means it is like that Jeremiah was delivered for they knew the rage of the king and of the wicked to be such that they could not escape without danger of their lives.
ninth month: Which contained part of November and part of December.
their garments: Showing that the wicked instead of repenting when they hear God's judgments, grow into further malice against him and his word.
hid them: Thus we see the continual care that God has over his to preserve them from the rage of the wicked.

another scroll: Though the wicked think to have abolished the word of God when they have burnt the book of it, yet this declares that God will not only raise it up again but also increase it in greater abundance to their condemnation as in Jer 36:32.
Why hast thou written in it: These are Jehoiakim's words.
none to sit upon the throne: Though Jehoiachin his son succeeded him, yet because he reigned but three months, it was esteemed as no reign.
dead body shall be cast out: Read Geneva "Jer 22:19"
